description:
The x402 service catalog, ordered by observed 30-day call volume. A listing is a claim; the observed columns are evidence — prefer `is_live` with non-zero `l30_unique_payers`. Note the path stays `/v0/endpoints` although the human page moved to `/services`; renaming it would break published integrations.

Wraps GET /v0/endpoints.
Access: no API key required.

Returns:
- endpoints: Catalog rows with price, network, payTo, liveness and observed demand.
- next_offset: Offset for the next page, or `null` when this page was the last.
- meta: The chain served and `as_of`. On an EMPTY list it also carries `dataset_last_written_at`, `dataset_row_count` and any `warnings` (e.g. `endpoints_catalog_stale`) — so a zero can be read as a quiet market or a stalled ingest rather than guessed at.

fields.description: `compact` returns name, resource, price, network, payTo and liveness only — no description, icon or tags — which is roughly a third of the payload.

limit.description: Rows to return. Clamped to 200; values outside the range are clamped, not rejected.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use the returned `next_offset`.

q.description: Free-text search over service name, description and resource URL.

name: list_services
title: Indexed x402 service directory
